Immutable Diagram Revisions
|-- Revision record: shared content identity, independent of canvas placement
|   |-- DiagramRevision.id = diagram.revisionId: service revision identity
|   |-- diagramId: stable service identity across revisions
|   |-- parentId: base revision ID for revise/derive; absent on creation
|   |-- diagram: immutable payload
|   |   |-- id: local canvas content key; revision: numeric content revision
|   |   |-- content: ASCII + SHA-256 + content revision ID + parsed structure
|   |   |-- sourceContext: content hash + optional binding + mappings + evidence
|   |   `-- Optional highlights and jumps
|   `-- nodeRefs: content node ID -> persistent logical node identity
|       `-- Parsed node IDs may change while logical identities continue
|-- Content and parsing [diagramContent.ts, asciiTree.ts, diagramContentNodes.ts]
|   |-- buildDiagramContent(ascii, revisionId, kind, version)
|   |   |-- At most 20000 characters; printable ASCII and LF only
|   |   |-- Nonblank, except a multiline rectangle of spaces for kind=diagram
|   |   `-- Parser version pins reproducible structure and node IDs
|   |-- kind=tree
|   |   |-- New content: ascii-tree-2; rebuilds can preserve ascii-tree-1
|   |   |-- parseAsciiTree -> shared interpreter in tree mode
|   |   |   `-- Zero tree/wire tolerance; separate continuations; no repairs
|   |   |-- Store roots and nodes with labels, positions, parents and children
|   |   |   `-- Node ID = content revision ID + ASCII hash + line number
|   |   `-- Descendants and fold ranges support lineage, subtrees and collapse
|   |       `-- visibleContentLines rejects unknown collapsed node IDs
|   `-- kind=diagram
|       |-- New content: ascii-graph-1 -> derive nodes from parsed boxes
|       |   `-- Preserve multiline spans; first span anchors node identity
|       |-- No stored parser version -> retain legacy interpreter derivation
|       `-- diagramContentNodes freezes and caches derived nodes by content object
|-- Prepare and issue revisions [diagramRevision.ts, diagramRevisionEditor.ts]
|   |-- createDiagram(input)
|   |   `-- prepareCreate -> constructDiagram -> issue revision without parent
|   |-- reviseDiagram(base, edit)
|   |   |-- source-mappings -> require expected hash to equal current ASCII hash
|   |   |   `-- Clone mappings/evidence; optionally replace source binding
|   |   |-- patch / patches -> patchDiagramRanges
|   |   |   `-- Apply continuity claims and optional supplied/retained mappings
|   |   |-- replace -> reconstruct at numeric revision + 1
|   |   |   `-- Rebase prior jumps/highlights; optionally retain source mappings
|   |   |-- jumps / highlights -> validate annotation changes
|   |   `-- Prepared diagram is the same object as base.diagram?
|   |       |-- Yes -> return the existing base revision
|   |       `-- No -> keep diagramId; assign fresh revisionId and parentId=base.id
|   |-- deriveDiagram(base, input, refs, sources)
|   |   |-- All identity-source revisions must belong to the same diagramId
|   |   |-- Each requested logical ref must exist in those sources
|   |   |   `-- Must select exactly one output node; no two refs select one node
|   |   `-- Issue fresh revision with base as parent and selected identities
|   `-- Shared issuance: issueDiagramRevision
|       |-- Assign each output node a logical identity
|       |   |-- Explicit derived identity, otherwise
|       |   |-- Base identity via old-node -> new-node correspondence, otherwise
|       |   `-- Fresh node UUID
|       `-- Deep-freeze record -> validateDiagram -> return revision and edit metadata
|-- Logical continuity and safe reads [diagramRevisionEditor.ts]
|   |-- correspondingNodes: exact matching only
|   |   |-- Requires identical ASCII and structure kind
|   |   `-- Match unique line + start/end columns + label
|   |-- Explicit nodeCorrespondence: old logical ref -> output line
|   |   |-- Ref must exist; integer line must identify exactly one output node
|   |   `-- Reject conflicts with inferred matches or duplicate output claims
|   |-- resolve(contextId, local diagramId)
|   |   |-- Canvas-history binding -> revision ID -> revision record
|   |   |-- Rewrite node, parent, child and active-jump anchors to logical refs
|   |   `-- Return a structured clone of DiagramView, not the revision payload
|   `-- merge(baseline, current, proposed)
|       |-- Any baseline/current binding difference -> MERGE_REQUIRED
|       `-- Otherwise copy proposed bindings; automatic three-way merge is absent
|-- Generated edits reuse the same revision path [submitDiagramEdit.ts]
|   |-- Verify requested base revision and local diagram identity
|   |   `-- New diagrams cannot supply replacementRanges
|   |-- Choose validation context: base -> request context -> placeholder
|   |   `-- Validate candidate; use context binding/evidence; combine continuity claims
|   |-- Base plus scoped edit ranges -> patches
|   |   |-- Preserve structure kind; scopedReplacements computes output ranges
|   |   |-- With requested source mappings: retain/shift mappings outside edits
|   |   |   `-- Add generated mappings inside output ranges, avoiding retained IDs
|   |   |-- Without requested source mappings: use retainMappings
|   |   `-- reviseDiagram -> return revision plus output replacementRanges
|   |-- Requested base without scoped ranges -> reviseDiagram with replace
|   `-- No requested base -> createDiagram at numeric revision 0
|-- Validation and source joins [diagram.ts]
|   |-- Require service IDs and valid local ID/numeric revision
|   |   `-- Saved diagrams lacking service identities require offline migration
|   |-- Rebuild content using its pinned parser and compare canonical structure
|   |-- sourceContext.contentHash must match SHA-256 of content.ascii
|   |-- Validate source binding, jumps, highlights and local mappings
|   |-- Evidence ranges: relative paths, valid line bounds, matching captured lines
|   |   `-- Each mapping must resolve to its evidence range and optional range ID
|   `-- diagramSource / queryDiagramSourceContext
|       `-- Join mapping -> evidence entity -> source range -> binding
|           `-- Expose entries, selection queries and case-insensitive search
`-- Explicit retention and publication boundary [diagramRevisionStore.ts]
    |-- Domain create/revise/derive/submit return results without storing them
    |-- importDiagramRevision
    |   `-- Require nonempty, unique logical refs for all content nodes -> register
    |-- retainDiagramRevision
    |   `-- Import -> get by revision ID -> return registry-held diagram and revision
    |-- Stored command wrappers = domain operation followed by retention
    |-- getDiagramRevision -> revision; listDiagramRevisions -> frozen ancestry summaries
    `-- Durable adapters flush retained revisions before publishing context bindings
